get.summary: List friends and pending friend requests

post.description: 204 also when the request was already sent. 409 when you are already friends or the user already sent you a request (accept it instead). 400 for yourself, 404 for an unknown user.
Accepts the request the given user sent you. Only the receiver can accept: 403 for the sender, 404 when there is no pending request between you.
Declines the request the given user sent you. Only the receiver can decline: 403 for the sender, 404 when there is no pending request between you.

delete.summary: Remove a friend or cancel a sent request
delete.description: 204 whether or not there was anything to remove, so a retry is harmless.

post.description: You become the owner. The members are optional and must all be your friends: 403 lists the ones who aren't. 409 when you are already in the maximum number of groups.

get.description: 404 when the group doesn't exist or you are not a member.

post.summary: Add a friend to a group
post.description: Any member can add their own friends. 204 also when they are already a member. 403 when the user is not your friend, 404 when the group doesn't exist or you are not a member, 409 when the group is full.

delete.summary: Leave a group, or remove a member
delete.description: With your own id you leave the group; when the owner leaves, the longest-standing member becomes the owner, and when the last member leaves the group is deleted. Only the owner can remove someone else (403). 204 also when the user was not a member. 404 when the group doesn't exist or you are not a member.

post.description: Like /api/plans/generate, but the group size is the number of members (the request's groupSize is ignored) and the plans are saved to the group. 404 when you are not a member; 400, 422 and 502 as for /api/plans/generate, and nothing is saved then.

Validates the preferences (400), filters the venue database (422 when too few venues match), lets the AI combine the remaining venues into plans, and checks every plan against the database before returning 2 or 3 distinct plans. 502 when the AI is unavailable or returns fewer than 2 usable plans.

post.summary: Alternatives for one stop of a plan
post.description: Swap a stop (#229): returns up to 5 copies of the plan with one stop replaced by another venue of the same activity that is open at that time, fits the budget (or costs no more than the stop it replaces when no budget is sent) and is at most 2 km further out of the way. Costs and distances are recalculated from the database. No AI call. 400 when the plan can't be read or a place in it no longer exists.

put.summary: Save a plan to the account
put.description: Idempotent: saving the same plan id again replaces it. Plan ids are per account, so another account saving the same id gets its own copy. The venues are looked up in the database (400 for an unknown venue); the body's plan id must match the URL. 401 when the account no longer exists, 409 when it is at its limit of saved plans.

delete.summary: Remove a plan from the account
delete.description: 204 whether or not the plan was saved, so a retry is harmless.

post.description: Returns the plan's public link, which anyone can open on the website without an account. Sharing an already shared plan returns the same link. 404 when the account has not saved the plan.

delete.description: The link stops working. Sharing the plan again gives a new link. 204 whether or not the plan was shared.

get.description: No account needed. 404 when the link is unknown or the owner stopped sharing it.

get.summary: Get the signed-in user's saved planning defaults

put.summary: Replace the signed-in user's saved planning defaults
put.description: Replaces all five defaults. Omitted or null fields clear the saved value. Supplied selections must be non-empty, supported and distinct. Budget is EUR per person; distance is kilometres. Returns 401 if the account no longer exists.

get.description: Case-insensitive match anywhere in the display name, at least 2 characters, up to 20 results, never including the signed-in user. Returns only ids and display names, never email addresses. Relation says whether you are friends or a request is pending.
